detail.title: Synthesis of Information Persistence Mechanisms
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes structural and behavioral models of information persistence. We bridge formal quantum error correction mechanisms—where redundancy and measurement mitigate entropy—with curiosity-driven learning dynamics—where informational value is calibrated against predictive error. This duality distinguishes physical data decay from the epistemic relevance required for long-term information survival.
